entities.summary: James Drummond Dole, the "Pineapple King", was an American industrialist who developed the pineapple industry in Hawaii. He established the Hawaiian Pineapple Company (HAPCO) which was later reorganized to become the Dole Food Company that operates in over 90 countries. Dole was a cousin of Sanford B. Dole, President of the Republic of Hawaii.
